title: Attenuation of senile pruritus by PAC-14028-mediated downregulation of the NF-kappaB and MAPK pathways.
authors: Yoon, Ji Hye; Woo, Byoung Young; Kim, Mi-Yeon; Cho, Jae Youl
journal: International journal of immunopathology and pharmacology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究PAC-14028通过TRPV1调控NF-kappaB和MAPK通路缓解老年瘙痒，虽含分子建模模拟，但核心是药物-蛋白互作而非蛋白质-DNA互作，与TF-DNA课题无关。
abstract: OBJECTIVE: Senile pruritus is a specific type of itching that occurs in elderly persons. Previously, we assessed antagonism of the nonselective ligand-gated cation channel transient receptor potential vanilloid 1 (TRPV1; capsaicin receptor or vanilloid receptor 1) and attenuation of atopic dermatitis by the non-steroidal TRPV1 antagonist PAC-14028 in clinical studies. The findings led us to postulate that PAC-14028 may also reduce itching in elderly people by antagonizing the TRPV1 pathway. In this study, we evaluated whether PAC-14028 modulates inflammatory markers present in senile pruritus. MATERIALS AND METHODS: HaCaT, RAW264.7, and differentiated THP-1 cells under itching-inducing conditions were treated with zymosan or IL-17A and variety of experimental approaches such as molecular modeling simulations, site-directed mutagenesis, overexpression strategies, confocal microscopy, mRNA analyses, and immunoprecipitation/Western blotting analyses were assessed to check changes in inflammatory markers and explore the underlying mechanisms of PAC-14028 activity. RESULTS: In the bioinformatic analyses, skin inflammation markers were found to be closely related to TRPV1, and the MAPK and NF-kappaB pathways were upregulated when TRPV1 was activated. In HaCaT cells, PAC-14028 was found to directly bind to TRPV1, inhibiting inflammatory cytokine gene expression and downstream MAPK and NF-kappaB signaling under various skin inflammatory conditions. CONCLUSIONS: By combining the results of multiple assays, we were able to elucidate the molecular mechanism of PAC-14028 to TRPV1. Taken together, the findings indicate that PAC-14028 as a potential therapeutic agent for elderly people with pruritus.
abstract_zh: 目的：老年瘙痒症是老年人中发生的一种特定类型的瘙痒。此前，我们在临床研究中评估了非选择性配体门控阳离子通道瞬时受体电位香草酸亚型1（TRPV1；辣椒素受体或香草酸受体1）的拮抗作用，以及非甾体类TRPV1拮抗剂PAC-14028对特应性皮炎的缓解作用。这些发现使我们推测，PAC-14028可能通过拮抗TRPV1通路来减轻老年人的瘙痒。在本研究中，我们评估了PAC-14028是否调节老年瘙痒症中存在的炎症标志物。材料与方法：在诱导瘙痒条件下，用酵母聚糖或IL-17A处理HaCaT、RAW264.7和分化的THP-1细胞，并采用多种实验方法，如分子建模模拟、定点突变、过表达策略、共聚焦显微镜、mRNA分析和免疫沉淀/蛋白质印迹分析，以检查炎症标志物的变化并探讨PAC-14028活性的潜在机制。结果：在生物信息学分析中，皮肤炎症标志物被发现与TRPV1密切相关，且当TRPV1被激活时，MAPK和NF-kappaB通路被上调。在HaCaT细胞中，PAC-14028被发现直接结合TRPV1，在各种皮肤炎症条件下抑制炎症细胞因子基因表达及下游MAPK和NF-kappaB信号传导。结论：通过结合多种检测结果，我们能够阐明PAC-14028对TRPV1的分子机制。综合来看，这些发现表明PAC-14028是治疗老年瘙痒症患者的潜在治疗药物。
